maria (PM): Quick sync: we need a concrete pilot plan for the Optimize toolkit features: eval-triggered alerts, tenant opt-in, quantization recommendations, and short guidance for batching/caching. ACME and two other customers pushed for predictable launch gates.

dev (Eng): High level: split into three workstreams: 1) detection & alert delivery, 2) recommendation engine (quant + batching hints), 3) console + API (apply/propose + audit). Feature flags for every piece.
\notas (typo)  <-- ignore this line

ojas (ML): For signals, propose: concordance_p95 (primary), hallucination_rate_top20 (safety), latency_p99 (perf). Detection window = 7d rolling; regression = relative drop >= 5% by default. Will publish a signal spec.

tess (CS): Customers want weekly scorecards and a critical webhook when "guardrail" prompts cross threshold. Also asked for short, human-readable explainers so their SREs can triage.

sam (SRE): Operational constraints: avoid pager storms. Suggest soft-firing rules: require persistence across 2 collection windows or 48h, plus tenant-level severity mapping. Also global cap: max 3 pager-worthy alerts per tenant per week in pilot.

maria (PM): Pilot acceptance (draft):
- Pilot scope: internal + 3 alpha tenants (one large, two midsize).
- Alert quality: precision >= 78% on top-60 prompts.
- Detection latency: median time-to-detect <= 6 days.
- Recommendation accuracy: when tenants apply quant recs, end-to-end quality delta < 1% in >= 88% cases.
- Batching/Caching guidance usefulness: at least one alpha reports measurable cost drop >= 8% after following a suggested batching/caching config.
- Pilot window: 6 weeks.

dev (Eng): Implementation notes: store summarized eval deltas + sketches for 90d, full traces 30d to cut costs. Webhook example we’ll send:
```
{
  "audit_id": "uuid",
  "tenant": "acme",
  "signal": "concordance_p95",
  "baseline": 0.912,
  "current": 0.865,
  "delta": -0.047,
  "recommended_quant": "int8-gptq",
  "expected_quality_delta_pct": 0.4,
  "expected_cost_saving_pct": 12.3
}
```
Signed via HMAC header. Rate-limits + exponential backoff on delivery.

ojas (ML): Recommendation scoring (early):
score = w_q*(quality_delta_pct) - w_l*(latency_ms/100) - w_c*(cost_saving_pct) + w_h*(hallucination_delta_pct)
Initial weights: w_q=1.0, w_l=0.35, w_c=0.25, w_h=1.5. Recommend profile if score <= 1.7. We'll run sims to tune.

tess (CS): CS asks for an "apply proposal" API rather than auto-apply for hosted customers. Dedicated customers can opt into auto-rollout under contract. All applies must create an immutable audit record with operator id.

sam (SRE): Add an auto-revert guard: if after apply, quality delta on top-20 prompts exceeds 1.5% within 24h, revert automatically for Dedicated tenants (opt-in) and send urgent webhook + email to tenant admins.

maria (PM): Batching & caching guidance: deliver as a companion "efficiency hint" card with recs like: "increase batch_size to 32 for route X, enable prefix KV cache for routes where avg prefix length > 64 tokens". Acceptance: at least one alpha sees >= 8% token-cost reduction when they apply the hints.

ojas (ML): For quant sims we'll sample prompts by bucket and run stratified A/B sims. Full sweep is expensive. Expect sims for 3 alphas in pilot. Posting baseline ROC/PR curves by EOW.

dev (Eng): Epics: alert core (ingest + rule engine), delivery (webhooks + digest + console card), recs engine (sim + score), UI/API (propose/apply + audit). Rough sizing next sprint planning.

tess (CS): Legal/consent: need explicit opt-in with revocation, clear retention windows. CS will draft the consent snippet and staging checklist for alpha customers.

maria (PM): Risks & mitigations: noisy alerts -> per-tenant thresholds and tuning + soft-window; storage costs -> summarize + TTL; incorrect recs -> human-in-loop for GA, auto-revert.

ops-bot: Feature flag created: ff/optimize-eval-precision-2026 on branch feat/optimize-eval. Staging env provisioned. CI job kicked. :white_check_mark:

maria (PM): OK owners: ML (ojas) -> sims + signal spec by friday; Eng (dev) -> epic cards + webhook contract by Tue; CS (tess) -> recruit 3 alphas and consent by EOW; SRE (sam) -> pager guard config & auto-revert plan. Weekly updates in this thread please.

ojas (ML): Acknowledged, will share initial sims and tuned weights by Friday.

dev (Eng): Will drop the webhook schema + retention numbers in the doc tomorrow.

tess (CS): Reaching out to ACME + two alphas today.

maria (PM): Great. If no objections, I'll convert this into a 1-pager PRD and tag owners. If anyone wants different numbers for the gates, call it out now. :thumbsup:
